name: qlrisk_catalog
title: qlrisk catalog
description: Discover what qlrisk can do before calling another tool. topic: 'products' (name='InterestRateSwap' for its trade schema), 'calculators' (credit, exposure, XVA, margin, SA-CCR inputs and config), 'stress_scenarios', 'report_measures', 'processes', 'market_data' (snapshot and risk-factor keys such as 'EQ.SPX'), 'enumerations', 'version'. Filter with name and category. Example: {"topic": "products", "category": "fx"} gives 6 qlrisk products in 1 categories on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
